problem: The function f(x) = (1/9)(x-4)^2 + 5 gives a toy car's height above the ground f(x), in inches, x seconds after it started moving on an elevated track, where 0 <= x <= 10. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the vertex of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane?

choices.label: A
choices.content: The toy car's minimum height was 5 inches above the ground.

choices.label: B
choices.content: The toy car's minimum height was 4 inches above the ground.

choices.label: C
choices.content: The toy car's height was 5 inches above the ground when it started moving.

choices.label: D
choices.content: The toy car's height was 4 inches above the ground when it started moving.

verified: logical: vertex form (x-4)^2+5 has vertex (4,5), a minimum since coefficient positive; x=4 is not the start (x=0), so correct interpretation is minimum height 5 inches, choice A

problem: The function f(t) = 10,000(2)^(t/350) gives the number of bacteria in a population t minutes after an initial observation. How much time, in minutes, does it take for the number of bacteria in the population to double?
verified: sympy: doubling time = exponent's denominator = 350 minutes, since f(t+350)=2*f(t)

problem: In right triangle ABC, angles A and B are acute, side AC has a length of 21.2, and tan B = 1/6. What is the length of side BC, rounded to the nearest tenth?
verified: sympy: right angle at C, tan B = opposite/adjacent = AC/BC -> BC = AC/tanB = 21.2/(1/6) = 127.2. Matches source's own circled selection (C).

problem: Point F lies on a unit circle in the xy-plane and has coordinates (1,0). Point G is the center of the circle and has coordinates (0,0). Point H also lies on the circle and has coordinates (-1,y), where y is a constant. Which of the following could be the positive measure of angle FGH, in radians?
verified: sympy/logic: H=(-1,y) on unit circle forces y=0, so H=(-1,0); angle FGH between (1,0) and (-1,0) is pi; coterminal positive angles are odd-integer multiples of pi (pi, 3pi, 5pi,...); among choices only 23pi is an odd integer multiple of pi (25/2 and 27/2 are not integers, 22pi is even), so D=23pi
